data.title: CPI Maps and Bitcoin $76,000-$83,000 Scenarios
data.description: Bitcoin is approaching Friday’s August CPI report near $78,000, with $80,000 as the key level before a potential move toward $82,000-$83,000. The inflation release is also central to expectations for the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy decision, as Treasury yields and the dollar remain important parts of the market backdrop for ...
